open_points.subject: MCP entrance and remote caller contract
open_points.question: Which MCP transport, protocol version, endpoint/path and connection framing must the surface expose at the listen address?
options: MCP Streamable HTTP at a fixed path
legacy MCP HTTP/SSE
another MCP transport selected by the installation
open_points.default_guess: MCP Streamable HTTP at one release-fixed path behind the reverse proxy.

open_points.subject: functions.add_trial_case file fixtures
open_points.text: “Input values by port, optional expected outputs”
open_points.question: How does an authored trial case provide the bytes for file inputs and expected file outputs, rather than only the digest, size and media-type facts accepted by fit_port_value?
options: carry file bytes inline in the request
reference a separately uploaded artifact
accept facts only and provide no authored file-fixture path
open_points.default_guess: Carry each fixture's bytes inline, with State 6 defining their typed MCP representation.

open_points.subject: functions.add_trial_case port maps
open_points.text: “Fit in port name order — presence, carriage, schema, size”
open_points.question: Must authored trial inputs, and expected outputs when present, contain exactly the contract's corresponding port names, or are extra names ignored or refused?
options: require an exact port-name set
refuse only missing ports and ignore extras
allow partial maps
open_points.default_guess: Require inputs to name exactly all input ports and, when expected outputs are supplied, refuse every unknown output name.

open_points.subject: TrialCase expected_outputs
open_points.text: “expected outputs, when present, fit the output ports”
open_points.question: When expected_outputs is present, must it contain every contract output, or may it assert only a subset while unmentioned outputs are merely validated?
options: all output ports are required
a subset is allowed and only named outputs are compared
each output is independently optional
open_points.default_guess: Require every output port when expected_outputs is present; absence of the whole field means validation without equality checking.

open_points.subject: flows.compose_flow_version constants
open_points.text: “ports, nodes, edges, guards, constants with declared classes” and “A constant's StoredValue takes the value_schema and class the composing agent declared with it”
open_points.question: Where in the composition input is each constant's declared value_schema supplied, and is it mandatory independently of the target port?
options: each constant supplies value, value_schema and disclosure_class
the target port supplies the schema
the kernel infers the schema from the JSON value
open_points.default_guess: Require every constant to supply its own value_schema and disclosure_class.

open_points.subject: NodeExecution failure detail
open_points.text: “Details of an element that concluded operation_failed ... are a closed set too” while M23 defines only “failure_detail: bounded, without secrets, when not succeeded”
open_points.question: Where is the closed machine-readable detail code such as binding_stale, credential_unresolved, value_too_large or cleanup_failed stored when the same execution may also have a bounded service or exception failure_detail?
options: add a separate detail_code field to NodeExecution
use failure_detail exclusively for the closed code and discard diagnostic text
encode both into one structured failure_detail field
open_points.default_guess: Add a separate optional detail_code and retain failure_detail as bounded diagnostic text.

open_points.subject: bindings.check_installed_instances
open_points.text: “an unreadable record, or one failing a check of the record itself (A08 rule 5), fails at its service” and “a service ... whose record lists no instance of the selected name, fails nothing here”
open_points.question: Which exact A08 rule 5 checks are ‘checks of the record itself’ at startup, given that rule 5 mixes service-record, capability, selected-instance, proposal-port and operation-specific checks and no operation or proposal ports are supplied here?
options: check only service-record structure and the selected instance's required headers
validate every capability except checks requiring proposal ports
run the full A08 proposal validation for every capability
open_points.default_guess: Check the service record's structural validity and the selected instance's required-header collisions only; leave invocability and proposal-port checks to proposal and send time.

open_points.subject: installation.current_token_list recovery
open_points.text: “Re-read when the file's digest changed or it cannot be read; ... a failed re-read leaves no list until one passes”
open_points.question: After a failed re-read clears the valid token list, must every later request retry reading the file even when the restored file has the same digest as the last previously valid file?
options: retry on every request while no valid list exists
retry only when the byte digest differs from the last successful read
forget the previous digest after any failed re-read
open_points.default_guess: Retry on every request while no valid token list exists, retaining no digest that can suppress recovery.
